findings.evidence: Roadmap README lines 47 and 51 say family entries exhaustively specify exactly which moments are targets; Fisher lines 451–452 list only mean, variance, and matching failures, whereas code lines 229–230 and 314–317 publish the full natural-moment threshold and beta quotient.
findings.fix: Keep any general-q machinery private and expose only the listed first/second-moment results, or have a human add general Fisher moments to the roadmap first.
findings.issue: `integrable_pow_fisherSnedecorMeasure_iff` and `integral_pow_fisherSnedecorMeasure` (line 314) add public results for every natural moment, while the Fisher entry targets only mean, variance, and their non-integrability thresholds.

summary: The requested Fisher mean, variance, and divergence thresholds fit Layer 3, but the PR also exposes off-roadmap all-natural-moment theory despite the roadmap’s explicit exhaustive scope.
